questions.q: What happened when a group of jinn heard the Prophet SAW recite the Quran at Nakhlah?
options: They believed and went back to preach to their people
questions.explain: The jinn listened in silence, believed, and preached to their people.

options: Protection a leader gives to someone else
questions.explain: Mut'im gave the Prophet SAW jiwar so he could enter Makkah.

questions.q: The first verse of which surah mentions the event of the Isra'?
questions.explain: Al-Isra' 17:1 says Allah took His servant by night.

questions.q: Where was the Prophet SAW taken on the night of the Isra'?
questions.explain: The Isra' was the Prophet's night journey from Makkah to Bayt al-Maqdis.

options: The highest station where the Prophet SAW met Allah
questions.explain: Sidrat al-Muntaha is the highest station of the Mi'raj.

questions.q: Why did Allah show the Prophet SAW the great realms after Taif?
options: To strengthen His Messenger's heart after the sorrow
questions.explain: After the sorrow of Taif, Allah strengthened His Messenger's heart.

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW do in remembrance of Mut'im's favour?
options: Was ready to free the Badr captives for his sake
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW valued people's favours even if they were not Muslim.

questions.q: What did the jinn admire about the Quran?
questions.explain: The jinn marvelled at the beauty of the Quran.

questions.q: The event of Isra' Mi'raj is easily understood by logic alone.
questions.explain: False. It is hard for logic to grasp, but Allah told of it, so we believe.

questions.q: We may joke around while the Quran is being recited.
questions.explain: False. Even the jinn listened in silence. We should be quiet and respect the recitation.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The Prophet's ascent to the heavens
The night journey from Makkah to Bayt al-Maqdis
The semicircular area beside the Kaaba

questions.explain: Jiwar is protection, the Isra' is the night journey to Bayt al-Maqdis, the Mi'raj is the ascent to the heavens, and Hijr Ismail is the area beside the Kaaba.

questions.q: Al-Aqsa Mosque is a blessed place. What should we do for it?
options: Pray for the liberation of Bayt al-Maqdis and Gaza
questions.explain: We pray for the liberation of Bayt al-Maqdis and Gaza.
